ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with approximately 95% dark pixel coverage and 5% high-intensity (white) localized regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark pigmentation across central and medial regions; high-contrast white mottling and stochastic spotting localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with an acute angle of approximately 55 degrees and a bounding-box depth equivalent to roughly 10% of the visible vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge; peak-to-valley amplitudes are most pronounced at the distal margins, particularly on the right lobe edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curvature on the trailing edge tapering to sharp distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-intensity white circular pixels located at the far lateral margins (tips) of both fluke lobes, consistent with localized surface scarring.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white pigmentation loss and irregular tissue margins at the distal tips of both lobes.
